svg.title: ProfiledPIDController: chase a moving setpoint
svg.desc: Animated graph of position over time, drawn left to right. A dotted line with a flag marks the goal: where you want to end up. The dashed blue setpoint, getSetpoint(), is where the plan says to be now: it moves smoothly along an S from start to the goal. The solid orange measured position chases it, a little behind, and a red bar between the two moving dots shows the gap the PID chases. The goal is where you want to end up; feed the setpoint's velocity to the feedforward. It runs on the roboRIO or SystemCore once every 20 ms loop, so it suits slower mechanisms better than a 1 kHz steering loop.
svg.text: A PID with a built-in trapezoid: you give a goal, it follows the moving setpoint.
